_about: kotoba-os unikernel-edge sizing budget (ADR-2606031600 §D6). HONEST STATUS: every number below is an ENGINEERING ESTIMATE (range, MiB), NOT a measured footprint. Real numbers require building the Hermit-derived no_std kernel + a WASM runtime + the minimal kotoba substrate for a concrete target and measuring; that build needs the 40-engine/kotoba subrepo + Hermit toolchain (N6 upstream coordination) and is an R2 deliverable. This file exists so the §D6 'sizing budget is honestly TBD' gap is replaced by a falsifiable, consistency-checked budget that the R2 measurement either confirms or corrects. Sources are reference-class, not product datasheets.
estimate_disclaimer: ESTIMATE (unverified) — confirm by measurement at R2
